page_title: BRE 3-2 WHU | Brentford v West Ham 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Thomas Bramall is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' The game is interrupted. Danny Ings (West Ham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+3' Emerson (West Ham) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
90+3' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitaly Janelt departs the field of play to be replaced by Ben Mee (Brentford).
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' We are about to witness a substitution. Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) is replacing Yoane Wissa.
87' Neal Maupay (Brentford) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
86' Emerson (West Ham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
83' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Thomas Bramall no option but to blow his whistle.
81' What a big chance! Pablo Fornals (West Ham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
80' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
79' A substitution has been made. Kristoffer Ajer is replaced by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
78' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) replacing Mathias Jensen.
77' The ball is behind the touchline and West Ham will take a throw-in.
73' The ball is cleared after Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

69' 3 - 2 It's a goal! Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) makes it 3:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Mathias Jensen and planted his close-range header into the top left corner. Alphonse Areola was helpless.
67' Neal Maupay (Brentford) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
67' The ball has crossed the sideline. Brentford are taking a throw-in.
65' West Ham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Here is a change. Mohamed Said Benrahma is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Fornals (West Ham).
64' It will be a substitution. Danny Ings (West Ham) is ready to enter the pitch as Michail Antonio walks off.
62' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Bramall ignores the protests.
58' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
55' 2 - 2 It's an own goal! Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) unluckily beats his own goalkeeper.
55' The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.
53' Although David Moyes (West Ham) is just on the bench, Thomas Bramall has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
52' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Tomas Soucek (West Ham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

51' What a wasted opportunity by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Thomas Strakosha makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
49' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
48' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mark Flekken is replaced by Thomas Strakosha (Brentford).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+6' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Brentford will have a corner.
45+5' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+4' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
45+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
45+2' A long ball forward to Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is intercepted.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle as Mathias Jensen (Brentford) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
44' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) commits a foul and Thomas Bramall immediately signals a free kick.
43' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
41' Michail Antonio (West Ham) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
40' It looks like Mathias Jensen (Brentford) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Bramall won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
33' The Brentford players are exchanging some short passes.
29' Referee Thomas Bramall points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes wild in celebration.
29' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The West Ham players aren’t happy.
26' 1 - 2 Goal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:2.
26' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
24' It's a yellow card for Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford).
23' Mark Flekken (Brentford) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
22' The game is interrupted now, Mark Flekken (Brentford) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' West Ham couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Mark Flekken (Brentford) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
19' 1 - 1 Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) produces a wonderful finish after latching onto a superb crossfield pass and firing the ball inside the left post!
18' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
16' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Brentford.
12' Emerson (West Ham) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
11' 1 - 0 Neal Maupay (Brentford) finds some space inside the box and powers his header past the goalkeeper, giving him no chance.
7' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Alphonse Areola makes a comfortable save.
6' Brentford have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
5' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Bramall interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' Neat passing move from Brentford in order to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Good clearance! Michail Antonio (West Ham) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
2' A player from Brentford commits a rough challenge. Thomas Bramall blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Brentford will have the kick-off.
Thomas Bramall is the one to supervise the game today.
